title: Cornucopias - COPI Cafe Episode 18
description:
In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Rob and Josh discuss mobile game testing, NFT2Tree Sale, Crypto Crow becoming an ambassador for Cornucopias. Geoff joins the guys for a minute for an announcement and more. Stay until the end for some game asset leaks. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. Crack open your favorite beverage, enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

Fair disclaimer: COPILeaks are brief glimpses into the game's mechanics as they currently stand. Everything we leak can be assumed to be unfinished, is subject to change, or may never be seen again. So enjoy it while you can, and be sure to share this COPILeak with everyone you know!
